integrity: Analytical proof and a standalone numerical diagnostic included; findings and review from the same mathematical analysis only; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only first-order Melnikov zeros are counted; no uniform-in-frequency or random-realization perturbation radius, no complete perturbed homoclinic-intersection census; Gaussian coefficients and positive frequency assumed. Priority not independently certified.
title: Sharp all-degree two-zero law for high-frequency Gaussian Melnikov splitting
